findings.title: Mould
findings.description: Dark mould growth across the lower half of the wall beside the window, with staining at the baseboard.
findings.where: Lower half of the wall, left of the window
findings.scenario: Visible mould, 10 to under 30 square feet in a room

deadline.starts: When HPD issues a violation notice after inspecting

citations.quote: the exact words quoted from the section go here
citations.supports: The class for mould of this size

explanation.summary: One or two plain sentences on what this is and why it matters.
explanation.landlord_duties: What the landlord must do and by when.
explanation.tenant_rights: What the tenant is entitled to.
explanation.tenant_responsibilities: What the tenant must do, such as allowing access for repairs.

next_steps.title: Tell the landlord in writing
next_steps.detail: Describe the condition; keep a copy and proof of delivery.

next_steps.title: File a 311 complaint
next_steps.detail: 311 sends it to HPD, which aims to inspect within 30 days.

next_steps.title: HP action in Housing Court
next_steps.detail: A judge can order the repair.

unclear.what_was_seen: Some lifting at the edge of the paint near the baseboard.
unclear.request: Take a closer photo of the paint in good light, at an angle that shows it lifting from the surface.

outcome_values.violation: A class and a deadline are known. Show them.
outcome_values.inspector_decides: A violation, but class is null. Show class_options (for example A, B, C) and no single deadline.
outcome_values.not_landlord_responsibility: The rule says this is the tenant's own duty, such as surface mould on intact grout. No class or deadline.
outcome_values.not_settled: The app found the problem but the sources don't settle the outcome. Show next_steps only.
outcome_values.needs_answer: The app can't choose until the tenant answers the items in questions. Show them as a short form, then call again with the answers.

_notes_for_designers.nothing_found: When true, findings is empty. Say so plainly.
_notes_for_designers.out_of_scope: When the photo shows something outside the decision tree, this is {description, tenant_responsibility}. It is where a Shopify suggestion would attach.
_notes_for_designers.no_boxes: The models describe where a problem is in words (the where field). They don't return coordinates, so don't design boxes drawn on the photo.
_notes_for_designers.arrival_order: Parts arrive at different times: detection at about 1 second, description at about 6, the law explanation at about 13. Design each part to appear when ready.
_notes_for_designers.unclear: Problems the app thought it saw but couldn't confirm. Not reported as problems. Show the request and let the tenant add another photo.
